snippet.title: Deified - Out Now on Steam
snippet.description:
Deified will leave early access on 21 September 2026.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/36...

Deified is a turn-based game where slot management and relic restoration are at the heart of the experience. Restore your artifacts by assembling multiple identical fragments, unlock new abilities, and strengthen your synergies by collecting relics of the same type.

Relics need slots to be used so choose them carefully: each one grants a unique bonus but also a drawback that shapes your playstyle. Progress through skill trees to refine your strategies, and unlock new rooms to give you more options in every run.
